title: Amelia | Open-Toe Block Heel with Ankle Strap
bodyHtml:
Step into effortless elegance with these modern block heels—designed to ground your look while keeping you steady all day long. The ankle strap delivers security and all-day comfort, while the open-toe silhouette keeps things fresh and breathable. A contemporary take on a wardrobe essential, perfect for everything from work to weekend.

Why you'll love it

  • Stable block heel means you can walk with confidence, no matter where the day takes you
  • Adjustable ankle strap sits just right—comfortable enough to wear for hours
  • Open-toe design keeps your feet feeling light and airy, even on warm days
  • Modern geometric heel shape is a real head-turner
  • Works with everything—dresses, trousers, jeans, midi skirts
  • The kind of shoe you'll reach for again and again
  • Hard to find a heel this versatile at this price point

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
